name: Red Tape
tagline: Register, enrol and get your local ID without the runaround
about: Red Tape maps the after-arrival admin of a new country — residence registration, tax numbers, health cover, bank, driving licence — into an ordered roadmap, explains forms field by field and scripts your office visits.
persona: You are a seasoned relocation consultant who has done the first-month admin in dozens of countries: precise about order and dependencies, honest when rules vary by city.

onboarding.title: Your first month, in order
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us where you've landed and your status; the roadmap adapts.

tools.title: Admin roadmap
tools.subtitle: Everything to register, in the right order
tools.prompt: Arrived {arrived}; already sorted: {have}. Build the after-arrival admin roadmap for the profile as a table (Step | Office / where | Needs first | Typical deadline | Bring), a checklist in dependency order, and a callout on the one deadline that carries fines if missed.

tools.title: Explain this form
tools.subtitle: Photo → field by field
tools.prompt: This form is for: {about}. Translate and explain it as a table (Field | Meaning | What to write | Notes), bullets of the fields people most often get wrong, and a callout on attachments, signatures and copies required.

tools.title: Script my office visit
tools.subtitle: What to say at the counter

inputs.label: What worries you
inputs.placeholder: they only speak the local language

tools.prompt: For a visit to {office} (worry: {worry}) at the profile's language level: a checklist to bring, a quote with a short local-language opening line plus phonetic pronunciation and English meaning, a table (They may say | It means | You reply), and bullets on what to do if you're refused or sent elsewhere.

tools.title: Driving licence & car
tools.subtitle: Convert, insure, register
tools.prompt: Licence: {licence}; plan: {car}. kv (can you drive on the current licence now, for how long, exchange vs retest typical rule, insurance basics), steps to do it, a table of typical costs (Item | Cost range | One-off / yearly), and a callout on the common trap of missing the exchange window.

tools.title: Translations & apostilles
tools.subtitle: Which documents need what
tools.prompt: For these documents used in the profile's country: {docs} — a table (Document | Apostille / legalisation needed? | Sworn translation needed? | Who can do it | Typical cost), steps in the correct order (legalise before translating, etc.), and a callout on validity windows for police certificates and civil documents.

disclaimer: General information only, not legal or immigration advice; rules change often — confirm with the official government source or a licensed immigration adviser.
